description: Stable six-family map for the Pattern Recognition / Discrimination Layer v16. The layer is a responsibility, not a mandatory technical component.

families.name: Peripheral signal
families.reader_question: What might the default path have overlooked?
families.purpose: Widen a task-scoped information aperture beyond the obvious route while treating every result as a candidate for inspection.
families.mechanism: Bounded alternate acquisition routes followed by source weighing, comparison, and disconfirmation.
observable_actions: write the default path
choose one to three bounded expansion routes
record candidate identity and acquisition result
send candidates through weighing and comparison before influence
boundaries: less-visible is a reason to inspect, not a reason to believe
peripheral is relative to the task and observed corpus

implementation_levels.lightweight: One bounded alternate route recorded in an evidence register.
implementation_levels.moderate: Route coverage, source identities, exclusion reasons, and missing-perspective check.
implementation_levels.advanced: Task-scoped route planner or corpus-coverage view with human review and a hard enrichment budget.

when_not_to_use: the question is purely administrative and no evidence choice is at issue
the task has no permission to acquire beyond supplied material
the consequence and time window make any expansion less valuable than a clear abstention

families.name: Source weighing
families.reader_question: What role does each source play for this exact claim?
families.purpose: Keep source role, relevant track-record evidence, claim-scoped authority, support, relevance, recurrence, origin, provenance, and permission distinct.
families.mechanism: Claim-level evidence records with typed relationships and explicit source roles.
observable_actions: split the answer into checkable claims
link each claim to exact passages
record source role, relevant track-record evidence, and claim-scoped authority separately
assess support, contradiction, qualification, or insufficiency separately
record origin and recurrence state
record acquisition, retention, disclosure, and action permissions

implementation_levels.lightweight: Four-column note: source role, relevant track-record evidence, what it supports, and what remains unknown.
implementation_levels.moderate: Claim-level evidence register with typed relationship states.
implementation_levels.advanced: Versioned source, artifact, derivation, and claim graphs with domain review.

when_not_to_use: the output is a purely creative transformation of user-supplied text and no factual claim is added
the task has no external evidence and a simple uncertainty note is sufficient

families.name: Velocity / motion
families.reader_question: What is changing unusually relative to a relevant baseline?
families.purpose: Notice a rate, direction, or change that merits examination against a defined history or comparison set.
families.mechanism: Repeated comparable time-stamped observations plus a stated baseline and measurement-change check.
observable_actions: define the measure and event-time rule
collect at least two comparable observations
state the baseline
check seasonality, measurement, denominator, and collection changes
label motion as observed, uncertain, or unsupported
boundaries: change is an attention prompt, not a conclusion
unusual motion is not a forecast

implementation_levels.lightweight: Current/prior comparison with written baseline and one alternative explanation.
implementation_levels.moderate: Versioned series with denominator, time window, and collection-change notes.
implementation_levels.advanced: Versioned time-series and anomaly tooling with domain-reviewed thresholds.

when_not_to_use: there is only one observation and no defensible baseline
the task cannot define comparable time or measurement boundaries

families.name: Absence + memory
families.reader_question: What should be present but is not, and what prior context changes the meaning of now?
families.purpose: Detect typed gaps against an expected baseline and retrieve relevant prior observations, decisions, corrections, and outcomes without overwriting history.
families.mechanism: Baseline-linked gap records and versioned, source-bound memory.
observable_actions: state what was expected and why
test whether the observation boundary supports a gap
classify missing, inaccessible, unauthorized, failed, stale, and superseded states
retrieve prior records by task, time, and source scope
link current interpretation without overwriting prior records
boundaries: a gap is not proof of nonexistence
private, deleted, unavailable, or unauthorized material is a typed gap
memory is not a timeless fact store

implementation_levels.lightweight: Expected/observed/unknown table with one prior-state citation.
implementation_levels.moderate: Append-only observations, corrections, and supersession links.
implementation_levels.advanced: Versioned memory retrieval with source-bound filters, stale flags, and correction workflows.

when_not_to_use: the task has no relevant prior state and no expected baseline
retaining the material would violate a stated minimization or deletion rule

families.name: Structured patterns
families.reader_question: What becomes visible through explicit comparison?
families.purpose: Compare peers, periods, attributes, structures, and relationships explicitly enough to expose recurrence, difference, and missing perspective.
families.mechanism: A declared unit of comparison, matched or intentionally asymmetric set, and typed relationship record.
observable_actions: define the comparison question and unit
align definitions, time windows, and denominators
mark matches, differences, unknowns, and incomparable fields
trace shared origin or pathway where recurrence matters
state what the comparison cannot establish
failure_modes: unknown origin forced into a label

implementation_levels.lightweight: Two- or three-row comparison table with explicit not-comparable cells.
implementation_levels.moderate: Versioned comparison matrices and origin notes.
implementation_levels.advanced: Typed relationship graph and queryable cohort definitions with human entity-resolution review.

when_not_to_use: there is no defensible comparison unit
the apparent peers differ on a decision-critical dimension that cannot be normalized

families.name: Learning loop
families.reader_question: What did we expect, what happened, and what bounded update is justified?
families.purpose: Compare recorded expectations, routes, decisions, costs, and defined outcomes, then propose a bounded update while preserving the original record.
families.mechanism: Outcome review with a predeclared outcome window, attribution boundary, missingness state, and dispositioned update proposal.
observable_actions: record expectation before the outcome window closes
define outcome and attribution boundary
capture observed outcome, cost, corrections, and confounders
compare expected and observed without rewriting the receipt
propose one bounded update
request authorized disposition before applying a policy or memory change
boundaries: learning proposes a bounded update; it does not silently apply one
a later outcome does not prove earlier reasoning was right or wrong

implementation_levels.lightweight: Expectation/outcome table with one proposed change.
implementation_levels.moderate: Append-only outcome reviews linked to receipts and versions.
implementation_levels.advanced: Approved matched-budget policy comparisons preserving null, harmful, shortcut, fragility, and non-transfer results.

when_not_to_use: there is no defined outcome or measurement window
the proposed update would affect external people or systems without an authorized review

invariants: Peripheral is a candidate status, not a truth status.
Technical access is not operational permission.
Human disposition is a decision record, not a fact.
Outcome learning proposes bounded updates and preserves history.
implementation_note: A conforming implementation may use any stack or no software beyond documents. The six families are responsibilities and checks, not mandatory components or a claim of effectiveness.
